title: celmisia semicordata subsp. stricta
intro: Celmisia semicordata subsp. stricta, commonly known as alpine daisy, is a species of flowering plant in the Asteraceae family, native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various ailments such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Celmisia semicordata subsp. stricta include soothing and calming effects, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
